The overview

Montego Bay is Jamaica's resort hub, ringed by reefs and beaches and backed by green hills, with reggae and jerk smoke in the air.

Top things to do in Montego Bay

  • Swim at Doctor's Cave Beach
  • Float down the Martha Brae river
  • Climb nearby Dunn's River Falls
  • Tour a great house plantation estate
  • Hit the bars on the Hip Strip

Best time to visit

The sweet spot for Montego Bay is generally year-round — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Is it safe?

Check your government's latest travel advisory. Watch your belongings in crowds and tourist areas, and check your government’s current advisory before you go. Visa for US passports: Check entry requirements for US passports.

A bit of history

Named by the Spanish, long a sugar-trading port under British rule, Montego Bay grew into a tourism center in the 20th century.

Culture & language

Jamaican culture gave the world reggae and Rastafari; expect patois, jerk cuisine, and a famously easygoing 'no problem' attitude.

Language: the local language · English spoken: varies
